svg.aria-label: Three ways in: terminal, Stack Builder, and AI agents over MCP. Mix languages in one project. One compatibility engine rejects invalid combinations. bts.jsonc records the stack so add, update, and check can extend it.
svg.text: Answer a few prompts, get a project.
Click your stack, download a ZIP.
Every project records its stack, so the CLI can extend it later.
Run later, in the same project.
